description:
Declare an Argo Workflow as an external Dagster asset.

Example:
    ```yaml
    type: dagster_community_components.ExternalArgoWorkflowAsset
    attributes:
      asset_key: argo/etl/nightly_aggregation
      workflow_template: nightly-aggregation
      namespace: argo
      argo_ui_url: https://argo.mycompany.com
      group_name: argo
    ```

workflow_template.label: Workflow Template
workflow_template.description: Argo WorkflowTemplate name (the reusable template; templates produce Workflows when triggered).

workflow_name.label: Workflow Name
workflow_name.description: Specific Argo Workflow name this asset represents (one-off runs, not template-derived).

namespace.label: Namespace
namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the workflow runs in.

argo_ui_url.label: Argo UI URL
argo_ui_url.description: Argo Server UI base URL — surfaced as a clickable link in the catalog.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
